# Chayce Properties — Full Content

> Chayce Properties is a full-service relocation partner across the UK, based in Northampton. We manage every stage of a move — sorting, packing, removals, estate agent liaison, legal coordination, storage, and post-move settling-in support — through a single dedicated coordinator. Every client is assigned one coordinator for the full journey, and all services are fully insured. Services are designed with senior clients in mind but are open to anyone planning a fully-managed move.

## Company Facts

- Name: Chayce Properties
- Website: https://chayceproperties.com
- Address: Unit F2B Barratt House, Kingsthorpe Road, Northampton, NN2 6EZ, United Kingdom
- Phone: 07708 925432
- Email: info@chayceproperties.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:30, Saturday by appointment
- Area served: United Kingdom
- Typical response time: within one working day, usually sooner

## Packages

All packages are fully insured. Each higher tier includes everything in the tier below it.

### Discovery Consultation — £150
A free-standing introductory consultation, not a commitment to any package.
- 1-hour telephone or in-person consultation
- Full assessment of your relocation needs
- Personalised move plan document
- Recommended timeline and budget breakdown
- Priority access to our full-service packages

### Bronze Essentials — from £995
Entry-level package for straightforward relocations.
- Professional packing of all rooms
- Fully insured removal to your new home
- Furniture reassembly at destination
- Light cleaning of vacated property
- Dedicated move coordinator

### Silver Comfort — from £1,850
Everything in Bronze Essentials, plus:
- Home sorting and declutter assistance
- Property staging for sale
- Utility transfer management
- Deep clean of vacated property
- Post-move unpacking and setup

### Gold Prestige — from £3,250
Everything in Silver Comfort, plus:
- Chauffeur-driven property viewings
- Estate agent liaison
- Solicitor coordination
- Full home staging with photography
- Storage solutions (up to 6 weeks)
- White-glove unpacking & styling

### Platinum Bespoke — from £6,500
Everything in Gold Prestige, plus:
- Fully bespoke & unlimited scope
- Personal lifestyle concierge
- New area orientation & introductions
- Interior designer consultation
- Ongoing post-move concierge support (3 months)
- Dedicated senior coordinator throughout

See https://chayceproperties.com/packages/ for the full side-by-side comparison.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What areas do you cover?**
We operate across the UK. Please contact us to confirm availability in your specific area.

**How early should I get in touch?**
As early as possible — ideally 3 to 6 months before your intended move date. However, we can accommodate shorter timescales where needed.

**How does the Discovery Consultation work?**
We conduct a detailed 1-hour consultation (in person or by telephone) to understand your needs and deliver a personalised move plan, timeline and budget.

**Can you help if I haven't sold my home yet?**
Absolutely. We can assist with preparation and staging to help you achieve the best possible sale price before you move.

**What makes Chayce different from a regular removal company?**
We are a full-service relocation partner, not just a removal company. We manage every aspect of your move — from sorting and packing to estate agent liaison, legal coordination, and post-move setup.

**Can I just book individual services?**
Our packages are designed to give you the best value and experience, but we can discuss bespoke requirements. Contact us to find out more.

**Are your services just for seniors?**
Our services are designed with seniors in mind, but we welcome anyone who values a premium, fully-managed relocation experience.

**Is my move fully insured?**
Yes. All removals carried out by Chayce are fully insured. Full details are provided in your service agreement.

**What should I expect after I send an enquiry?**
You can expect a response to your enquiry within one working day, and usually much sooner.

**Do I have to decide on a package before contacting Chayce Properties?**
No, you don't need to know which package you want beforehand; the team will help you determine what fits your needs once they understand your situation.

**Is there any pressure to book when I reach out?**
No, there is no obligation or pressure to book anything; your conversation will be relaxed and focused on determining if Chayce Properties is a good fit for you.

- [Choosing the Right Relocation Partner for Your UK Move](https://chayceproperties.com/blog/choosing-relocation-partner-uk-move/): the questions worth asking before hiring a relocation partner — insurance, coordination, and what actually happens on moving day.
